notes: Synthetic stand-in for open-wanderer/wanderer#670, a 121-point out-and-back at real-watch density (about 4.003 m hops) with a real 60 m climb, an equal descent and +/-1 m barometric-style noise. elevationLoss equals elevationGain and is never 0: a real descent is never mistaken for noise. Nothing in this file comes from the issue's attachment.
